title: Utilities
summary: Optional cross-collection tools. They help a professional establish reusable working context before a task begins; they never perform the task and never become a prerequisite for a workflow skill.

skills.title: Pharma Work Context
skills.workflow: Build, update, refresh and export portable work context for pharmaceutical and biotech professionals, so an assistant understands role, sources, constraints and approval rules before attempting work.
never: a substitute for qualified scientific, regulatory or medical judgement
skills.rename_note: Renamed 2026-08-05. The prior identifier carried a trailing 'builder' suffix that the naming grammar bans. It was retained only because it was the single published identifier; deleting the prior repository and its release removed that compatibility obligation entirely, so the exception was closed rather than carried forward. See PS-D013.
